title: Full map symbol candidates
description: Full-map inventory of 165 capacity squares, 465 approach-penalty marks, 11 hill markers, and 43 objective stars. Candidate geometry is source-image pixels; stacked objective stars are separate features.

coverage.symbols: Full terrain/map area, excluding exact map furniture bounds: 165 capacities, 153 artillery, 89 cavalry, 22 infantry, 96 obstruction, and 105 impassable marks; 11 hills and 43 objective stars (14 blue, 11 red, 9 green, 9 black).
coverage.method: Capacity values, hill elevations, regular penalty subtypes, and all four objective-star colors were reviewed in enlarged source contact sheets. The impassable catalogue reference crop was used to distinguish crossed outlined bands from infantry crosses. Stacked objective stars are separate records. The 12 reviewed pilot penalties, 2 capacities, 1 hill, and 1 objective are represented. The newly exposed margin and southeast map areas were scanned with exact furniture masks; new capacity values were crop-read, and edge penalty marks were screened visually. Existing features were preserved and additions required at least 12px center separation from the same feature type. Exact furniture masks exposed eight additional capacity squares, three standard penalty rectangles, one obstruction bar, and eleven impassable bowties. Existing features were preserved; new detections were added only when no same-type center was within 12px.
coverage.limits: Feature localization and locale/approach associations remain draft outside the reviewed pilot. Newly uncovered map margins and southeast were screened visually; full-board recall has not been independently measured, so faint marks may still be missed.
